component.name: Ritmo
component.summary: A DAW with sample chopping built in

description.p: Ritmo is a complete music app for Linux that runs on just a laptop. Build beats from patterns, arrange them in a playlist, write melodies in the piano roll and mix them with the built-in drums, electric piano and bass, through a lo-fi master chain.
Its chop sampler takes any audio file, chops it onto 16 pads at its hits, in even slices or by tapping along, and lets you pitch, reverse and sequence the chops like any other instrument.

ul.li: Patterns, a free-form playlist with looping clips, and a loop range
Piano roll with note length, velocity, selection, copy and paste
Chop sampler for WAV, FLAC, MP3, OGG and AIFF files
A synth, and pitch, tone and envelope on every instrument
Mixer with EQ, filter, delay and reverb sends, and meters
Metronome, undo and redo for every edit
Projects saved as readable files, with autosave; export to WAV

description.p: First public release: projects and autosave, undo, the chop sampler, a free-form playlist, piano-roll editing, a synth and sound controls, mixer effects, metronome and audio settings.
